name: post-hook
description:
POST /auto-install/installations/{uuid}/post-hook

Handles the post-installation hook for all installations.

params.name: $schema
params.description: Metadata of the hook, such as schema version of the document.

params.name: boot-info
params.description: Information about the system boot status.

params.name: cpu-info
params.description: Information about the CPU(s) installed in the system

params.name: debian-version
params.description: major.minor version of Debian as installed, retrieved from /etc/debian_version

params.name: disks
params.description: All disks detected on the system.

params.name: dmi
params.description: Collection of various DMI information categories.

params.name: fqdn
params.description: Fully qualified domain name of the installed system

params.name: machine-id
params.description: Unique systemd-id128 identifier of the installed system (128-bit, 16 bytes)

params.name: network-interfaces
params.description: All network interfaces detected on the system.

params.name: product
params.description: Information about the installed product itself.

params.name: reboot-mode
params.description: Action to take after the installation completed successfully.

params.name: ssh-public-host-keys
params.description: Holds all the public keys for the different algorithms available.

params.name: token
params.description: Per-installation token issued together with the answer.

permissions.description: Authenticated through the per-installation token issued together with the answer.
